items.stem: 짝지어진 단어의 관계가 나머지와 다른 것은?
choices: ability – skill
goal – aim
delete – remove
waste – trash
safe – dangerous
items.explain: ⑤는 반의어, 나머지는 유의어.

items.stem: 다음 대화의 빈칸 ⓐ~ⓓ 중 어느 곳에도 들어갈 수 없는 표현은?
items.box:
G: Mr. Choi, ⓐ______ become a good magician like you?
M: Well, watch lots of videos about magic tricks and practice them every day.
G: ⓑ______. I'll do my best.
M: ⓒ______!

B: Hey, Jisoo. You're here for this class, too!
G: Hi, Brian. Do you like rap music?
B: Sure! I'm interested in making beats.
G: That's cool. ⓓ______ writing lyrics.
B: Let's team up!
choices: how can I
Got it
Good luck
I'm into
What kind of
items.explain: ⓐ how can I ⓑ Got it ⓒ Good luck ⓓ I'm into. What kind of 는 들어갈 자리가 없다.

items.stem: 아래 (A)~(C)를 대화의 흐름에 맞게 순서대로 배열한 것은?
items.box:
G: Did you know that dolphins sleep with one eye open?
(A) Oh, I get it.
(B) They keep one eye open to stay safe.
(C) Really? Why?
items.explain: 놀람·이유 묻기(C) → 이유(B) → 이해(A).

items.box:
Kate: Jia, how much trash have you (A)[picked / pick] up?
Jia: I have picked up five bags.
Kate: Really? I couldn't even fill two bags.
Jia: I come here often, so I know (B)[where / how] to find the trash.
Kate: Do you go plogging in the mountains often?
Jia: Yes. I have plogged (C)[for / since] a year.
Kate: Wow, you're great.
Jia: (D)[Although / Because] it is hard, I'm happy to help the Earth. It's also good for my health.
Kate: That's true. The air is so fresh.
Jia: How was today for you?
Kate: I was happy to help the planet although I didn't pick up much.

items.stem: (A)~(D)에 들어갈 어법에 맞는 표현으로 가장 적절한 것은?
items.explain: have + 과거분사 / 어디에서 찾을지 where to / for + 기간 / 힘들지만(양보) Although.

items.stem: 위 대화를 읽고 답할 수 없는 것은?
choices: How many bags of trash has Jia picked up?
Why does Jia know where to find the trash?
How long has Jia plogged?
How many bags did Kate fill today?
Why is Jia happy to go plogging?
items.explain: Kate 는 두 봉지도 채우지 못했다고만 했다.

items.stem: 다음 영영풀이에 해당하는 단어 중 위 대화에서 찾을 수 없는 것은?
choices: to make something full
things that you throw away because you do not need them
a very high hill
the state of being well and free from illness
a container for storing trash
items.explain: ① fill ② trash ③ mountain(s) ④ health ⑤ bin — 대화에 없다.

items.stem: 다음 두 문장을 접속사 although를 이용해 주어진 해석에 맞고 어법상 바르게 영작한 것은?
items.box:
비록 그는 매우 피곤했지만, 그는 회의에 참석했다.
• He was very tired.  • He attended the meeting.
choices: Although he was very tired, he attended the meeting.
Although he was very tired, but he attended the meeting.
Despite he was very tired, he attended the meeting.
He attended the meeting although was very tired.
Because he was very tired, he attended the meeting.
items.explain: ② although 와 but 을 같이 쓰지 않는다 ③ despite 뒤에는 절이 못 온다 ④ 주어 he 누락 ⑤ 뜻이 다르다.
items.source: 통합본 L6 문법 A-01 · 학습지 Grammar Point B

items.box:
Date & Time: September 15, 5:30 p.m.
It's a sad day for me. This morning, I (A)<u>went</u> scuba diving at my favorite spot in the sea. It was a place (B)<u>that</u> was full of beautiful and colorful corals. But today, I saw that corals (C)<u>were getting</u> sick. I was shocked. (D)<u>Because</u> the warm seawater, corals have turned white. Different types of waste have harmed the corals, too. Now the spot (E)<u>has lost</u> its colors and beauty. I'm really worried.

items.stem: 윗글의 (A)~(E) 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?
items.explain: 뒤에 명사구(the warm seawater)가 오므로 Because of.

items.stem: 윗글의 It was a place에서 It이 가리키는 것으로 가장 알맞은 것은?
choices: the sea
the sad day
my favorite spot in the sea
scuba diving
the warm seawater
items.explain: 바로 앞 문장의 my favorite spot in the sea.

items.stem: 윗글에 대한 설명으로 옳은 것의 개수는?
items.box:
• It's a sad day의 It은 날짜·날씨·상황을 나타내는 비인칭 주어이다.
• go의 과거형은 went, 과거분사형은 gone이다.
• a place that was full of의 that은 who로 바꿔 쓸 수 있다.
• saw that corals의 that은 생략할 수 있다.
• shocked는 '충격을 받은'이라는 뜻으로, shocking으로 바꿔 써도 뜻이 같다.
• have turned는 과거에 일어난 일이 현재까지 영향을 미치는 현재완료이다.
• spot은 'a small place or area'로 풀이할 수 있다.
• waste는 'to hurt someone or something'으로 풀이할 수 있다.
choices: 3개
4개
5개
6개
7개
items.explain: 옳은 것 5개. 선행사 a place → which(who ✗), shocking 은 '충격적인'(✗), 'to hurt ~'는 harm 의 풀이(✗).
items.source: 학습지 p106 필기 · L6 Crossword 영영풀이

items.box:
What Do I Have to Do Now?
First, focus on your school subjects now.
(A) Second, gather information about jobs that interest you.
(B) They give you the basic skills for your future. These skills help you make good choices.
(C) Finally, keep trying new things! Your interests can change often.
(D) You can watch videos and movies, or read books about them. This way, you can learn about real work in those jobs.
(E) It is very important for you to (가)<u>experience</u> different activities.
Our world keeps changing, and jobs will also change. Keep exploring, and you'll find your dream job soon.

items.stem: 윗글의 흐름에 맞게 (A)~(E)를 순서대로 배열할 때, ★에 들어갈 것으로 가장 알맞은 것은?
items.explain: (B) 과목이 기본 기술을 준다 → (A) Second, 정보 모으기 → (D) 영상·책으로 → (C) Finally, 새로운 것 시도 → (E) 다양한 활동 경험. ★은 (D).

items.stem: 윗글의 (가)experience의 영영풀이로 가장 적절한 것은?
choices: to do or feel something or learn from it
to decide what you want from two or more things
to teach someone the skills of a particular job or activity
to travel to or around an area in order to learn about it
to do something again and again to get better at it
items.explain: ② choose ③ train ④ explore ⑤ practice.

items.stem: 다음 문장의 빈칸에 and가 들어갈 수 없는 것은?
choices: Eat more vegetables, ______ you'll feel better.
Study hard, ______ you'll pass the test.
Take this medicine, ______ your fever will stay high.
Call me later, ______ I'll tell you the answer.
Wear a coat, ______ you'll stay warm.
items.explain: 약을 먹어라, 그렇지 않으면 열이 계속 높을 것이다 → or.

items.stem: 「명령문, and/or」를 If로 시작하는 문장으로 어법상 바르게 변형한 것은?
choices:
Leave early, and you'll catch the first bus.
→ If you leave early, you'll catch the first bus.

Hurry up, or you will be late for school.
→ If you hurry up, you will be late for school.

Take the subway, and you'll save money.
→ If you don't take the subway, you'll save money.

Exercise regularly, or your health will get worse.
→ If you exercise regularly, your health will get worse.

Study hard, or you'll fail the test.
→ If you study hard, you'll fail the test.
items.explain: 「명령문, or」는 If you don't ~ 로 바꾼다. ②④⑤ don't 누락, ③ and 인데 don't 를 넣었다.

items.box: When I was a child, I loved making (   ) and telling stories. My first job was (   ) a secretary, but I lost it. I taught English (   ) children, but that job ended too. I wanted (   ) be a writer. So I started writing stories (   ) children, and I became a famous writer. I wrote the Harry Potter series.

items.stem: 윗글의 빈칸에 들어갈 수 없는 것은?
choices: up
as
to
for
with
items.explain: make up(지어내다) / job as a secretary / taught English to / wanted to be / stories for children.

items.stem: 윗글의 내용과 일치하는 것은?
choices: The writer's first job was teaching English.
The writer lost the job as a secretary.
The writer never wanted to be a writer.
The writer wrote stories for adults first.
The writer taught English to old people.
items.explain: 첫 직업은 비서였고 그 일을 잃었다.

items.stem: 다음 우리말을 주어진 단어를 모두 한 번씩 사용해 영작할 때, 열두 번째에 오는 단어는?
items.box:
비록 병든 산호들을 치료하는 데 시간이 걸렸지만, 그 노력은 가치 있었다.
→ (although, it, took, time, to, heal, the, sick, corals, it, was, worth, the, hard, work)
(*단, 대소문자는 구분하지 않음.)
choices: heal
time
worth
took
hard
items.explain: Although it took time to heal the sick corals, it was worth the hard work. 열두 번째는 worth.

items.stem: 다음 문장의 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고친 것으로 옳지 않은 것은?
choices: I have <u>visiting</u> Jeju island before. → visited
He <u>has won</u> the prize last year. → won
She <u>worked</u> here for three years, and she still works here. → has worked
I have <u>know</u> him since 2024. → known
My aunt has <u>went</u> to Germany. She's not in Korea. → been
items.explain: 독일에 가서 지금 없으므로 has gone to(결과). has been to 는 '가 본 적 있다'.

items.box:
A Journey to Find My Dream
Some of you have a dream job in mind, but others do not. (A)<u>여러분이 미래 직업을 찾는 것은 쉽지 않다.</u> But we all need to answer the question, “What do you want to be in the future?” (B)<u>Think about the following questions, and you will find a path to your future job.</u>
Why Do We Work?
First, we work (가)<u>to make</u> money. Our jobs help us (나)<u>get</u> paid so we can make a living. Second, we work to take on social roles. For example, street cleaners keep our towns and cities (다)<u>clean</u>, and police officers make our society (라)<u>safely</u>. We rely on others to do these important jobs, and everyone has a special role to play. Third, we work to feel proud of our work. By (마)<u>working</u>, we can help others and show our abilities. In the end, we work to find meaning in life.

items.stem: 밑줄 친 (A)를 바르게 영작한 문장은?
choices: It is not easy for you to find a future job.
It is not easy of you to find a future job.
That is not easy for you to find a future job.
It is not easy for you finding a future job.
It is not easy for you to finding a future job.
items.explain: 가주어 It + easy + for 목적격 + to부정사.
items.source: L5 본문 1단락 · 학습지 Grammar Point A

items.stem: 윗글의 (가)~(마) 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?
items.explain: make + 목적어 + 형용사 → safe. (나) help + 목적어 + 동사원형, (다) keep + 목적어 + 형용사, (마) by + 동명사.

items.stem: 윗글의 밑줄 친 (B)와 의미가 같은 것은?
choices: If you think about the following questions, you will find a path to your future job.
If you don't think about the following questions, you will find a path to your future job.
Although you think about the following questions, you will find a path to your future job.
Think about the following questions, or you will find a path to your future job.
Because you think about the following questions, you won't find a path to your future job.
items.explain: 「명령문, and …」 = If + 주어 + 동사 ~, 주어 + will ….

items.stem: 윗글을 읽고 답할 수 없는 것은?
choices: What question do we all need to answer?
What do street cleaners do?
Why do we take on social roles?
How much money do we need to make a living?
What can we do by working?
items.explain: 생계에 필요한 돈의 액수는 나오지 않는다.

items.box:
Date & Time: October 2, 10:00 a.m.
I have thought about how to help corals. My plan is (A)<u>to form</u> a team of divers. My team can go underwater and take care of the   (가)   corals. Many corals get   (가)   because they don't get good care in time. I'm sure that other divers are worried about this, too. I'm going to post a message online to look for volunteer divers.
Date & Time: November 7, 9:40 p.m.
For the last two weeks, my team ⓐ<u>has put</u> ointment on   (가)   corals. We also took some healthy baby corals from the sea and put them in tanks of seawater. We feed them clam parts and seaweed smoothies. This food helps baby corals ⓑ<u>grow</u> stronger. When they ⓒ<u>are</u> ready, we'll plant them onto the corals in the sea. Our goal is ⓓ<u>to grow</u> many healthy corals. I look forward to ⓔ<u>see</u> the results!

items.stem: 윗글의 빈칸 (가)에 공통으로 들어갈 단어가 아래 ①~⑤의 빈칸에 사용되었을 때, 문맥상 가장 적절한 것은?
choices: I stayed home because I was (     ).
We had a (     ) picnic on the sunny day.
The (     ) building is 100 years old.
She was (     ) to win the first prize.
The (     ) river runs through the city.
items.explain: (가) sick. 아파서 집에 있었다.

items.stem: 밑줄 친 (A)to form과 to부정사의 쓰임이 같은 것은?
choices: I went to the battlefield to help sick soldiers.
My goal is to become a nurse.
I have a lot of homework to do.
She studied hard to pass the exam.
I was happy to hear the news.
items.explain: (A)는 보어 역할의 명사적 용법. ①④ 부사적(목적) ③ 형용사적 ⑤ 부사적(감정의 원인).

items.stem: 윗글의 ⓐ~ⓔ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?
items.explain: look forward to + 동명사 → seeing. ⓐ 현재완료(계속) ⓑ help + 목적어 + 동사원형 ⓒ 시간 부사절은 현재시제 ⓓ 명사적 용법(보어).

items.stem: 다음 영영풀이에 해당하는 단어 중 윗글에서 찾을 수 없는 것은?
choices: to give food to a person or an animal
to begin to exist or to make something begin to exist
something that you are trying to do or achieve
a type of sea animal with a shell in two parts and a soft body that can be eaten
to make someone who is ill become healthy again
items.explain: ① feed ② form ③ goal ④ clam ⑤ heal — 글에 없다.

items.stem: 다음 표의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?

box.title: Unusual Jobs

Golf Ball Diver: I collect golf balls from ponds at golf courses.

A pet food taster checks the taste before the food is sold.

A professional sleeper tests new beds by sleeping on them.
items.explain: 골프공 잠수사는 골프장의 연못에서 일한다.

items.stem: 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
items.box:
It is kind of him to help those in need.
It is exciting for we to play soccer.
Be quiet, and you can hear well.

Minsu has been to China twice.

3개
4개
5개
6개
